_note: Trial 21 (20 November 2026): how a question is looked up in the published research, after the editor's probe of thirty-five everyday questions: staying in the body and drug tests asked as detection, date rape and spiking as papers say them, the reasons why people take a drug, what a drug does to the body, and a second drug named in a question as a key word by its page's name. Our own questions. To be read line by line.
